title: Statute of Limitations in Utah — Provo Guide
metaDescription: Utah car accident deadline: 4-year SOL for most injury claims in Provo. Educational guide — verify dates with counsel.
excerpt: Educational Provo, UT guide — 4-year SOL, local hospitals, and insurer tactics. Not legal advice.

sections.heading: Utah deadline overview
paragraphs: Most Utah car accident injury lawsuits must be filed within **4 years** of the injury date. Missing this deadline can permanently bar recovery.
Wrongful death, government-entity, and minor claimant cases may follow different rules. This article is educational — confirm your dates with a licensed Utah attorney.

sections.heading: Why waiting hurts Provo claims
paragraphs: With ~thousands of annual crashes in the Provo area, evidence fades fast: skid marks wash away, witnesses relocate, and video is overwritten.
Insurers begin building a file immediately. Early recorded statements can lock in descriptions before you know the full extent of injuries.

sections.heading: Comparative fault in Utah
paragraphs: Utah follows 51% bar rules. If you are found partially at fault, compensation may be reduced or barred depending on your percentage.
Document everything that supports the other driver's negligence — traffic citations, 911 calls, and witness statements.

sections.heading: Insurance minimums and coverage gaps
paragraphs: Utah requires at least 25/65/15 in liability coverage (verify current law). Many at-fault drivers carry only minimums.
Review your declarations page for UM/UIM, MedPay, and PIP. These coverages can matter when the other driver is uninsured or underinsured in Provo.

sections.heading: Government and special entities
paragraphs: Claims involving city buses, state vehicles, or federal property often require earlier notice than the standard 4-year window. Missing a notice deadline can defeat an otherwise valid claim.

sections.heading: Practical timeline for Provo residents
paragraphs: Day 1–7: Medical care, police report, insurer notification (facts only).
Week 2–8: Follow treatment plans, gather bills, avoid social media posts about the crash.
Month 2+: If injuries continue, consult counsel before accepting settlement releases.

faq.question: What is the statute of limitations in Utah?
faq.answer: Most injury claims face a 4-year deadline, but exceptions apply. Verify your dates with counsel.
